svg.text: Contoso Global Financial Services — AZ-700 Capstone
WAF Policy • Global Load Balancing • SSL Offload
• Hub-Spoke topology with UDR forced tunneling • VPN with BGP dynamic routing
• Private Link for PaaS isolation • DNS Resolver for hybrid name resolution
• DR replica with Global VNet Peering • Firewall Manager central policy
• Cross-region Private Endpoints • AVNM connected group membership
VNet Design • Peering • VPN/ER • Firewall • AppGW/WAF • Front Door • Private Link • DNS • Load Balancing • Monitoring • Security • AVNM
1. Multi-region failover with Front Door + AppGW backend pools 2. Hub-spoke with forced tunneling (UDR 0.0.0.0/0 → FW NVA)
3. S2S VPN with BGP (ASN planning, route propagation) 4. Private Link + DNS zone integration across peered VNets
5. AVNM security admin rules (deny overrides) 6. Network Watcher diagnostics (flow logs, connection monitor, NSG diagnostics)
